newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stall before bulls move in.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stall before bulls move in.

text.p: U.S. T-bonds are set for a short period of consolidation before they gather enough momentum to head towards 111-00, technical analysts said on Tuesday.

Independent technical analyst Elli Gifford said support around 109-20 would likely hold. "The market does look due for a touch of consolidation," she said. "But broadly speaking, even though it's overbought, the T-bonds will want to go higher."
By 0921 GMT, the June T-bond was down 5/32 in automated trade at 110-07.

Gifford said the next target for the contract was the Fibonacci projection at 111-00. This is 61.8 percent of the move up from 106-30 on April 28 to 110-10 on May 2, added on to the May 8 low of 108-30.
"Immediately above that, there are several rally peaks from the beginning of the year which subsequently became supports. The 111-08 area will probably prove quite heavy resistance," Gifford added.

Marc Ostwald at London Bond Broking noted T-bonds were struggling to get out of their recent range. "T-bonds are stuck in the same old dilemma," he said. "They are gradually scratching away at this 110-10 resistance area and have widened it out to 110-16 but that is the key determinant." He said the market was pricing in a weak retail sales number, due at 1230 GMT, so it could easily recoil from that area.
"If we can break through there then we've got another resistance area at 110-24," he said, citing a target from the 110-25 low from February 3.
"Above that we've got a trendline coming in at 111-04," he said. That is the long down trendline drawn off the December 3 high.
Support this session would come in around 109-24, heavy congestion from last year and near lows from Monday and Tuesday last week, said Ostwald.
By 0937 GMT the September Eurodollar contract was down 0.005 at 93.935.
